## Summary

- **Total services inventoried:** 33 (21 T1 + 10 T3 + 2 T2 pillars) — matches spec.
- **Total CustomSections files to relocate (T1 + T3-with-customs):** 21 separate `./components/<X>CustomSections.jsx` (or analogue) module imports across T1 files —
  - Foundry T1: `APICustomSections`, `IoTCustomSections` (2)
  - Reimagine T1: `BlockchainCustomSections` (1)
  - Shield T1: `FinanceRiskCustomSections`, `QECustomSections` (2)
  - Platforms T1: `EPICustomSections`, `PimcoreCustomSections`, `SalesforceCustomSections`, `ServicenowCustomSections`, `GlobalCapabilityCentersCustomSections`, `TalentOrgCustomSections`, `SupplyChainCustomSections`, `USMCustomSections` (8)
  - Growth T1: `CDPCustomSections`, `MarketingAISections` (non-standard name), `SocialMediaCustomSections`, `PerformanceMarketingCustomSections`, `SEOCustomSections`, `FunnelCustomSections`, `CROCustomSections`, `CampaignPlanningCustomSections` (8)
  - Plus T3-surprising inline JSX sections (no separate file): BigData (1 inline block, ~185 lines), TechnologyConsulting (2 inline sections, ~500+ lines), StrategyConsulting (1 inline section, ~125 lines), DiscoverFrameWorkshops (3 inline sections, ~360+ lines) — these need to be either extracted to component files or carried over as inline JSX in the canonical pages.

- **Anomalies found (count + brief enumeration):** ~30+ noteworthy anomalies, including:
  1. **Stale department breadcrumbs (~20 files)** — every T1 and many Growth files reference legacy `/department/<old-slug>` (digital-engineering, emerging-technologies, business-operations, enterprise-applications, product-engineering, digital-marketing, conversion-engineering) instead of canonical `/department/foundry|reimagine|shield|platforms|growth`. Highest-priority normalisation target.
  2. **Slug mismatches with spec:** `blockchain-engineering` (spec: `blockchain`), `seo-organic-growth` (spec: `seo-organic-growth-strategy`).
  3. **Display-name vs title-fields mismatches:** Servicenow (`name: 'ServiceNow Services'` / `titleHighlight: 'Transformation.'`), Campaign Planning (`name: 'Campaign Planning'` / titleLine1+Highlight render "Growth Campaign Architecture."), CDPStrategy and MarketingAIReadiness `name` fields end with a trailing period.
  4. **Trailing-period inconsistency:** Many titleHighlights end with `.`, others (PerformanceMarketing "Marketing", SEOOrganicGrowthStrategy "Strategy") don't.
  5. **Empty `philosophy.title`:** TalentOrganization, SupplyChain — leaves "Highlight"-only headline.
  6. **6-layer matrix:** Only MarketingAIReadiness uses a 6-phase matrix (Diagnose/Prioritize/Prepare/Pilot/Govern/Scale); every other T1 uses 4 layers.
  7. **Remote Vimeo video URL:** PerformanceMarketing uses a token-signed Vimeo URL (`https://player.vimeo.com/external/494191410.sd.mp4?...token...`) for `videoBackground` — fragile and likely to expire.
  8. **Unused imports flagged:** SalesforceArchitectureShowcase (imported, not used), WhyPerformanceMattersSection (imported, not used in PerformanceMarketing), TechValueOptimization (TrendingDown, DollarSign unused — Important: the spec mentions a known `TrendingDown` bug in GenAIBusinessServices, but this pillar also imports `TrendingDown` without use), TechnologyLedGrowthStrategy (5+ unused icons), QualityEngineeringAssurance (Link + ~16 lucide icons unused), and many others have wide lucide import lists with sparse use.
  9. **Broken/legacy hardcoded links** in inline JSX of T3 services: BigData links to `/services/ai-cognitive/agentic-ai`, `/services/analytics-insights/analytics`, `/services/analytics-insights/data-science` (data-science is not a current slug); DiscoverFrameWorkshops links to `/services/digital-engineering/mvp-acceleration`, `/services/product-engineering/product-digital-engineering`, `/services/infrastructure-networks-operations/modernization-infrastructure` (legacy department paths); TT pillars (both T2) back-link to `/services/digital-transformation-modernization/technology-transformation`.
  10. **Non-functional `<button>`** in TechValueOptimization hero ("Analyze My Spend" has no onClick/Link).
  11. **Image path conventions split:** T2 pillars use `/assets/images/services/...`, most T1/T3 use `/images/...` or Unsplash/Pexels remote URLs.
  12. **Typo in technology category:** Blockchain technologies list "Cordna" (likely "Corda").
  13. **Component import name typo:** APIMicroservicesEngineering imports `DeliveryModelTimelline` (double-L).
  14. **Capability item-shape inconsistency:** Most T1 files use flat string `items: [...]`; ServiceNow + most T3s (ManagedCloudServices, MicrosoftServices, GoogleCloudServices, CloudComputing, Analytics) use object-shape `items: [{ heading, description }]`. Big Data and AWS use flat strings + `description` field at the capability level only.
  15. **Stray semicolons/syntax oddities:** DiscoverFrameWorkshops has `;` at line 234 after capabilities array. TechnologyConsulting mutates `service.technologiesTitle` after object literal.
  16. **`useCases` vs `industries`:** 11 of 21 T1 files (IoT, Talent, SupplyChain, USM, SocialMedia, PerformanceMarketing, SEO, GrowthFunnels, CRO — and others) define `useCases` then remap to `industries` in pageData; others define `industries` directly.
  17. **`hideGenericMidPageCta: true`** present on all 8 Growth T1 + Talent + SupplyChain + USM (11 total).
  18. **`ctaSecondaryButton`** used in CDP, MarketingAIReadiness, CRO, CampaignPlanning, IoT (rare).
  19. **No `videoBackground` on hero** for several Platforms/Growth: SupplyChain, USM, SocialMediaManagement, AWS, MicrosoftServices, GoogleCloudServices, CloudComputing, ManagedCloudServices, Analytics, BigData. SupplyChain instead uses a non-standard `trustPillarsVideo` slot.
  20. **Inconsistent `LogoTrustSection` naming**: Both PerformanceMarketing and SEOOrganicGrowthStrategy import a `LogoTrustSection` from different paths — easy to confuse during component relocation.

- **Cross-cutting notes:**
  - **All 8 Platforms T1 (except SupplyChain & USM) and all 4 Enterprise Apps T1 share the same hero video** `/videos/business-meeting-6774639.mp4` — heavy reuse of one asset (also used by FinanceRiskManagement, EnterprisePlatformIntegration, Pimcore, Salesforce, Servicenow, CDPStrategy, MarketingAIReadiness, SEOOrganicGrowthStrategy, GrowthFunnelsConversion, ConversionRateOptimization, CampaignPlanning, TechnologyConsulting, StrategyConsulting, DiscoverFrameWorkshops). `/videos/engineering-rd-bg.mp4` is the secondary asset (IoT, Blockchain, GCC, Talent). `/videos/network-4916894.mp4` only on QualityEngineering.
  - **All T1 files share the same GSAP counter-animation useEffect** (~30 lines) — candidate for shared utility/hook extraction during PR 2.
  - **All T1 files end with a wrapper `<div className="<service-name>-page-override">` + inline `<style dangerouslySetInnerHTML>`** for stat-counter tabular-nums + z-index reset — except SupplyChain, USM, SocialMediaManagement, PerformanceMarketing, SEO, GrowthFunnelsConversion, CampaignPlanning (which skip the wrapper or use a partial override).
  - **All 8 Platforms T1 use a 4-stat layout** with verb-style values (or numeric mix), except FinanceRiskManagement which uses purely numeric percentages.
  - **All 10 T3 files lack `breadcrumb` and `titleLine1/titleHighlight` split fields** — they only set `name`. They will need breadcrumb + title split synthesis during canonical migration.
  - **Both T2 pillars are standalone bespoke React components** (~358 + 174 lines) — they do NOT consume `ServicePageTemplate` at all, so they cannot be merged into the canonical `technology-transformation` service via the same PREMIUM_REGISTRY mechanism used for T1/T3. They need to be either (a) decomposed into individual JSX sections passed through `postCapabilitiesSections`, or (b) preserved as standalone nested route components under the canonical Reimagine/technology-transformation URL.
  - **Capability-count distribution across T1:** ranges from 4 (Servicenow) to 14 (QualityEngineering). Average ≈ 8. T3 ranges from 3 (Analytics) to 11 (CloudComputing).
